summary: AI Brief Generation (Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview via emergentintegrations) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/13 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_briefgen.py — POST /api/briefs/{id}/generate correctly requires Bearer (401), returns 404 for missing/cross-user briefs, returns 400 'Attach at least one photo first' when no photos are attached. Positive extraction works: for a synthesized referral-letter PNG (Maria Elena Rodriguez, DOB 1978-04-12, Warfarin 5 mg once daily / Metoprolol 50 mg twice daily / Atorvastatin 20 mg at night, Penicillin (rash) / Sulfa (hives), reason 'Persistent atrial fibrillation for cardiology review') the API returned status=complete, generated_at populated, share_url_path='/public/briefs/<32-hex>', patient.name & dob verbatim, medications with dose+frequency, allergies with reaction, referral_reason close to verbatim. Hallucination guard PASSED: a visually-featured but medically-empty noise+shapes PNG returned medications=[], allergies=[], patient fields all null, referral_reason null. PDF endpoint OK: watermark=true returns 200 application/pdf, %PDF magic, size >5 KB, Content-Disposition set; watermark=false returns a different (smaller) PDF; ?token=<bearer> query alt-auth works; 400 'Brief has not been generated yet' when content is null; 401 without any auth. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): signed-in test1@anteroom.dev → /brief-view?brief_id=<generated> renders testIDs brief-view-screen, brief-view-upgrade-ribbon (free user), brief-view-qr (SVG present), brief-view-pdf-btn ('Download PDF (watermarked)'), brief-view-edit-btn navigates to /brief-draft?brief_id=<same>. Extracted patient name 'Maria Elena Rodriguez', DOB '1978-04-12', 'Warfarin 5 mg once daily', 'Metoprolol 50 mg twice daily', 'Penicillin / rash' all render on screen. /brief-draft with photos + no content shows brief-draft-generate-btn. Nothing-invented UX for the blank image: brief-view renders testID brief-view-empty with 'Nothing readable was extracted', and every section shows 'Not detected on the pages.' as required. **CRITICAL BLOCKING BUG**: the public share endpoint /public/briefs/{share_token} (mounted OUTSIDE /api on FastAPI) is NOT reachable through the Kubernetes ingress at https://medical-brief-setup.preview.emergentagent.com/public/briefs/... — the ingress only forwards /api/* to the backend, so requests to /public/briefs/... are served by the Expo frontend and return the app HTML (status 200) instead of the FastAPI-rendered share page. This means the QR code and any 'Open link' the user scans will hit the frontend HTML, not the actual brief. Confirmed with curl to http://localhost:8001/public/briefs/... which correctly returns the FastAPI 404-HTML with title 'Brief not found — Anteroom' and status 404 — proving the backend implementation is correct; only the ingress routing is missing. No React Native or Expo deprecation issues found in the touched code.

critical.issue: Public share route is defined on the FastAPI app OUTSIDE the /api router (server.py:798), but the k8s ingress only forwards /api/* to backend:8001. External GET https://medical-brief-setup.preview.emergentagent.com/public/briefs/<token> is served by the Expo frontend (returns index.html, 200) instead of the FastAPI handler. Verified backend-side works: curl http://localhost:8001/public/briefs/deadbeef... returns the FastAPI 'Brief not found' page with the correct Anteroom styling and status 404. Impact: the QR code embedded in the brief-view screen and in the PDF points to a URL that is unreachable — the public share flow is broken end-to-end for any user who scans it. Fix options: (a) move the route to /api/public/briefs/... (simplest, keeps ingress unchanged, requires PDF/QR to include /api in the URL), OR (b) add an ingress rule that forwards /public/* to backend:8001, OR (c) have the Expo frontend at /public/briefs/[token] proxy the fetch to the backend.

integration_issues.issue: The QR code encodes the share_url_path pointing to https://<host>/public/briefs/<token>, which — due to the ingress routing bug above — resolves to the Expo frontend HTML instead of the FastAPI share page. Not a frontend implementation bug per se; frontend correctly builds the URL and renders the QR, but the destination is broken.

action_items: Fix public-share routing so /public/briefs/{token} is reachable externally. Recommended: move route to @api_router.get('/public/briefs/{share_token}') and update _public_share_url() in server.py:750 to return f'{base}/api/public/briefs/{share_token}'. Also update PDF share-URL generation and QR-code target in brief-view.tsx accordingly. After the fix, retest the two failing cases in test_briefgen.py::TestPublicShare (unknown token 404 & no-auth 200 with patient name + med names in the body).
(Optional) Consider adding a Retry-After-style server hint on generation timeouts (currently returns 502 with 'Brief generation failed' — no client guidance). Not tested but worth a follow-up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:798 — public route is mounted on `app` outside the `/api` prefix; this is inconsistent with the ingress contract that only forwards /api/*. Every non-/api backend route (including the /public/briefs page and, incidentally, the /api/health probe if any exists at root) is unreachable from the outside world. Prefer keeping every externally-reachable endpoint under /api.

briefgen.py:82 _extract_json uses `re.search(r'\{.*\}', text)` greedy which is fine, but the emergentintegrations response may already be a dict. Consider a fast-path `if isinstance(raw, dict): return _sanitize(raw)` before regex.

server.py:722 — share_token is regenerated only if missing; if a user regenerates the same brief the token is reused (good for stable QR), but share_expires_at is always reset to now+7d — that means an existing shared link's expiry moves forward silently on every regen. Probably intended, but worth noting in docs.

briefgen.py:148 sends up to the first 10 photos (server.py:707 cap). For a multi-page referral this is generous, but there is no size/megapixel cap; a user uploading 10 x 8MB scans could push a very large payload to Gemini. Consider a bytes budget or client-side downscale on upload.

success_rate.backend: 85% (11/13). The 2 failing tests both fail solely because /public/briefs/{token} is unreachable through the ingress — the FastAPI handler itself is verified correct via localhost curl.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all requested testIDs present, extraction rendered verbatim, nothing-invented empty-state renders correctly, generate button appears on drafts with photos, edit button navigates back to /brief-draft with the same brief_id.

seed_data_creation: Under test1@anteroom.dev — brief_478707f0a5dc (referral image, fully generated, share token 1a0a081f950f4d158f99db2090f32ea3), plus several throwaway briefs from the pytest module (some with the referral image generated, one blank-image generated for the hallucination-guard test, one with photos but no /generate call for the pdf-400 test). Also registered a fresh qa_{ts}_gen@anteroom.dev for the cross-user-404 test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The share-URL routing bug is the only blocker. After the main agent fixes routing, re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_briefgen.py -v` — TestPublicShare::test_unknown_token_returns_404_html and TestPublicShare::test_public_share_renders_no_auth are the two that should flip green. The Expo auth screen defaults to 'Create your account' — must click the 'Sign in' toggle text once, then the primary submit is `page.get_by_text('Sign in', exact=True).last`. Gemini 3.1 Pro extraction on the referral image takes ~15-25 s cold; increase requests/playwright timeouts to 90-120 s. For frontend testing, always set mobile viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: CRITICAL: /public/briefs/{token} unreachable externally. Reproduction: curl https://medical-brief-setup.preview.emergentagent.com/public/briefs/deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef → 200 with the Expo `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><title>frontend</title>...` body; same path on http://localhost:8001 → 404 with the FastAPI 'Brief not found — Anteroom' HTML. Root cause: k8s ingress rule maps only /api/* to backend service (as documented in the environment prompt). server.py:798 declares `@app.get('/public/briefs/{share_token}')` outside the `/api` router, so the route exists in FastAPI but has no ingress path exposing it. Mitigation (choose one): (1) prepend the route with /api — cheapest, self-contained: change decorator to `@api_router.get('/public/briefs/{share_token}')` and update `_public_share_url` (server.py:750-752) to return `f'{base}/api/public/briefs/{share_token}'`; the QR generator in brief-view.tsx already uses share_url_path so no frontend change needed if we also update the response builder (`_brief_to_out` at server.py:351) to prefix the returned share_url_path with /api. (2) Extend ingress to route /public/* to backend — requires infra change. Option (1) is safest and does not require any deployment/infra changes.
